title: VTA Attestation — Report — payload
description: Asks an agent for fresh attestation evidence bound to a nonce the verifier chose. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

nonce.description: Thirty-two bytes the verifier generated for this request, lowercase hex. The agent binds exactly this into the evidence, so no earlier report can answer this request.

teeType.description: The platform that produced the evidence, and so how to verify it.

evidence.description: The platform's quote, base64: a COSE_Sign1 attestation document for nitro, an attestation report for sev-snp. Verified against the vendor's root, never trusted on the agent's word.

nonce.description: The request's nonce, echoed. A verifier checks the nonce inside the evidence, not this.

vtaDid.description: The DID the evidence binds as its user data. A verifier checks the evidence binds it and that it is the response document's issuer.

generatedAt.description: When the evidence was produced. Informational: freshness comes from the nonce.
